_note: Only exceptions to ordinary numerical coverage are listed. 'partial' blocks a deterministic engine verdict when the compared page uses the rune. 'excluded' means the effect does not occur in the champion-fight scenarios and is intentionally worth zero there.

partial.Fleet Footwork: Healing and short movement speed are modeled; mana/energy restoration, the next-attack 40% Attack Speed clause, and exact energized timing are contextual.
partial.Aery: Damage, shield and return cooldown are modeled, but exact travel distance and whether each cast attacks or shields depend on positioning and ally targeting.
partial.Grasp of the Undying: Champion damage and the ranged modifier are modeled; permanent Health earned from earlier lane procs is match-history dependent.
partial.Phase Rush: Movement speed and Ability Haste are approximated; the one-time 20% current basic-cooldown refund and exact three-hit trigger timing are not modeled.
partial.First Strike: The three-second damage window is modeled; whether the user struck first and its gold income are not.
partial.Empowerment: Proc damage and the post-three-attack 8% amp are modeled from the expected attack timeline; interruptions and exiting champion combat remain contextual.
partial.Arcane Comet: Base proc, ratios and cooldown are modeled; the per-hit growth of later comets is not accumulated.
partial.Ice Overlord: Damage and its temporary resistance layer are modeled and CC-gated; zone slow and sticking value are not.
partial.Guardian: Self/ally shields and ally proximity uptime are modeled; exact guard targeting and damage threshold are contextual.
partial.Gathering Storm: Uses the documented 15-minute value; actual value depends on game time.
partial.Manaflow Band: The completed 300-mana value is modeled; actual stacking progress depends on earlier champion hits.
partial.Nimbus Cloak: Uses a fight-uptime movement estimate because the engine does not receive summoner-cast timing.
partial.Transcendence: The 10 Ability Haste is modeled; the level-9 per-ability cooldown refund is not.
partial.Perseverance: Tenacity is modeled permanently and the resistance window is approximated; enemy immobilize timing is contextual.
partial.Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats are modeled as a fresh-fight ceiling; uptime after falling below 65% Health is contextual.
partial.Eyeball Collector: The engine assumes completed stacks; takedown progress is match-history dependent.
partial.Zombie Ward: Completed adaptive stacks are modeled; ward takedowns and vision utility are match-history/context dependent.
partial.Last Stand: Uses an expected low-health uptime rather than an incoming-damage timeline tied to the user's current Health.
partial.Legend: Bloodline: The guaranteed 1% omnivamp is modeled; seven takedown/farm stacks are not granted for free.
partial.Legend: Alacrity: The maximum 18% Attack Speed is modeled for the full-build comparison; actual farm/takedown stack progress is match-history dependent.
partial.Legend: Haste: The maximum 15 Ability Haste is modeled for the full-build comparison; actual farm/takedown stack progress is match-history dependent.
partial.Overgrowth: Thirty stacks and the 3% threshold bonus are modeled; indefinite later farming is not assumed.
partial.Revitalize: The unconditional 5% is modeled; the additional low-health amplification is disclosed as contextual.
partial.Bone Plating: Represented as a conservative fight-level reduction; exact damage blocked by the next three champion hits is unavailable in the source data.
partial.Second Wind: The documented healing and melee doubling use a 40% missing-Health fight state; exact repeated-damage timing is contextual.
partial.Axiom Arcanist: Ultimate damage amplification is modeled, including the AoE split; ultimate healing/shielding amplification is not yet included in support value.
partial.Unshakeable: The ordinary one-enemy 5% Armor/MR state is modeled; nearby-enemy count can raise it to 9% and the three-enemy slow resistance is contextual.
partial.Hextech Flashtraption: Engage mobility is real but has no direct damage or durability value inside the synthetic fight.
partial.Triumph: The first simulated takedown in the sequential 1v3 grants its heal; exact missing Health, resource value, movement value and later takedowns remain contextual.
partial.Hubris: The first simulated takedown in the sequential 1v3 grants 6 Adaptive Force for the remaining window; prior-match champion kills and later takedown stacking remain contextual.

excluded.Demolish: Affects turrets only, not champion combat.
excluded.Botanist: Plant and gold utility is outside champion combat.
excluded.Ixtali Seedjar: Plant/trinket utility is outside the synthetic fight.
excluded.Relentless Hunter: Out-of-combat movement is rotation/map utility, not an in-fight stat.
